claims.author: moonsettler
claims.harm: standard 520-byte OP_CAT enables open-ended second-order effects such as assembling SIGHASH or CTV templates on the stack for unintended introspection
claims.quote: It explicitly disables open ended second order effects by removing the ability to assemble a SIGHASH or CTV template on the stack for more detailed introspection than intended.

claims.author: rot13maxi
claims.harm: untested combinations of SCRIPT_VERIFY_DISCOURAGE_OP_CAT and SCRIPT_VERIFY_OP_CAT risk unexpected consensus or mempool behavior
claims.quote: Since this is the first time we're carving out an OP_SUCCESS and doing this, it would be great to have a test that exercises the combinations of SCRIPT_VERIFY_DISCOURAGE_OP_CAT and SCRIPT_VERIFY_OP_CAT

settled_by.quote: Added some additional unit tests to script_tests.json testing different combinations of scripts with and without (SCRIPT_VERIFY_DISCOURAGE_OP_CAT, SCRIPT_VERIFY_OP_CAT and SCRIPT_VERIFY_DISCOURAGE_OP_SUCCESS)

claims.author: achow101
claims.harm: merging a consensus opcode change without project or community consensus
claims.quote: there does not appear to be consensus for the concept of OP_CAT in TapScript yet, so this PR cannot be merged even if the code is okay.

changes: claim c:2424200438 added (open, blocking) by achow101

notes: PR is blocked by maintainer achow101 converting to draft citing lack of consensus for OP_CAT in Tapscript. Moonsettler's objection regarding introspection scope remains open, while rot13maxi's request for verification flag combo testing was resolved by the author.
